description: A complex type that contains general information about the hosted zone.

Id.description: The ID that Amazon Route 53 assigned to the hosted zone.

Name.description: The name of the domain. For public hosted zones, this is the name that you registered with your DNS registrar.

CallerReference.description: The value that you specified for CallerReference when you created the hosted zone.

Comment.description: A comment for the hosted zone.

PrivateZone.description: Whether the hosted zone is private.

ResourceRecordSetCount.description: The number of resource record sets in the hosted zone.

name: HostedZone
